questions.q_en: Suppose you set up a Level 1 Golden Gate reaction and forgot to add the BsaI, but everything else went in and you plated it as usual. What would you expect on the plate and on the colony PCR gel, and why?
questions.q_zh: 假設你們做 Level 1 Golden Gate，忘了加 BsaI，其他東西都加了，照平常方式塗盤。你預期平板上和菌落 PCR 的膠上會看到什麼？為什麼？
kw_zh: 每一道都是空載體大小
questions.a_en: I would expect colonies, and all of them wrong. Without BsaI nothing is cut, so T4 ligase has no new ends to join. The only intact circle in the tube is the pSTK-1 destination vector, which still carries its sfGFP dropout and its ampicillin marker, so it transforms DH5 alpha and grows perfectly well. On the colony PCR gel every lane would sit at the empty vector size, which is one of the outcomes we already score as negative. It would look very like our first MoClo screen, where the bands sat at one height across almost every lane. We have not run that control, so this is a prediction.
questions.a_zh: 我預期會長菌落，而且全是錯的。沒有 BsaI 就沒有東西被切開，T4 ligase 也就沒有新末端可以接。管子裡唯一完整的環就是 pSTK-1 目標載體，它還帶著自己的 sfGFP dropout 和 ampicillin 抗性，所以照樣轉進 DH5 alpha 並長得很好。菌落 PCR 的膠上，每一道都會落在空載體的大小，那正是我們本來就判為陰性的結果之一。看起來會很像我們第一次 MoClo 的篩選，幾乎每一道的帶都在同一個高度。這個對照我們沒有做過，所以這是推論。
questions.trap_en: Saying there would be no colonies. The uncut destination vector carries its own resistance marker, so colonies do appear; it is the band size, not the plate, that gives the mistake away.
questions.trap_zh: 回答說不會長菌落。沒被切的目標載體自己就帶抗性基因，所以還是會長；真正露出破綿的是帶的大小，不是平板。
questions.basis: reasoning question; no answer written on the wiki

questions.q_en: Imagine a single extra base slipped into codon five of the SamyQ signal peptide during PCR. What would your anti-His blot and your Level 0 colony PCR each show, and which step in your workflow catches it?
questions.q_zh: 假設 PCR 時在 SamyQ 訊號肽的第五個密碼子多插進一個鹼基。你的 anti-His blot 和 Level 0 菌落 PCR 各會顯示什麼？你們流程裡哪一步會抓到它？
questions.a_en: The blot would show nothing at all, not a smaller band. SamyQ is thirty-one codons, so one extra base at codon five throws every codon after it out of frame, including the six-histidine tag at the end, and a random frame hits a stop codon within a few dozen codons. No tag means no anti-His signal and no mature protectant. The colony PCR is useless here: our BoPep4 Level 0 screen runs at five hundred and thirty-six base pairs, and five hundred and thirty-seven runs in the same place on agarose. Only the Level 0 sequencing catches it, which is why that step was added.
questions.a_zh: Blot 上會完全沒有訊號，不是出現一條比較小的帶。SamyQ 是三十一個密碼子，第五個密碼子多一個鹼基，後面每一個密碼子都位移了，包含結尾的六個組胺酸標籤；而隨機讀框通常幾十個密碼子內就會撞到終止密碼子。沒有標籤就沒有 anti-His 訊號，也沒有成熟的保護蛋白。菌落 PCR 在這裡沒有用：我們 BoPep4 的 Level 0 篩選是 536 bp，537 bp 在膠上就是同一個位置。只有 Level 0 定序抓得到，這也正是當初加上那一步的理由。
questions.trap_en: Predicting a band at a slightly lower molecular weight, as if a frameshift truncated the protein cleanly. A frameshift scrambles everything downstream, so the epitope the antibody needs is simply not there.
questions.trap_zh: 預期會出現一條分子量稍低的帶，好像位移只是把蛋白乾淨地截短。位移會把下游整段打亂，抗體要認的抗原決定位根本不存在。
questions.basis: derive it in the room; nothing written down for this case

questions.q_en: You run a Level 1 assembly with a pSTK-0C donor and a pSTK-1 destination, and by mistake you plate on chloramphenicol instead of ampicillin. What grows, and what will your screen tell you?
questions.q_zh: 你用 pSTK-0C 的供給質體和 pSTK-1 目標載體做 Level 1 組裝，結果誤塗在 chloramphenicol 而不是 ampicillin 的盤上。什麼會長起來？你的篩選又會告訴你什麼？
kw_zh: cam 選到的是供給質體
組裝好的在 amp 上
questions.a_en: Chloramphenicol selects the donor, not the assembly. Our pSTK-0 entry vectors are chloramphenicol resistant and the Level 1 destination vectors, 1A to 1D, are ampicillin resistant. So that plate grows leftover uncut donor plasmid carried over from the reaction and nothing that was actually assembled. I would get colonies, and the Level 1 screening primers would give no product in any of them, because the Level 1 junction is not in those cells at all. The fix is to restreak on ampicillin. This is the same marker logic that made us drop pGEM-T Easy, which shared ampicillin with the destination.
questions.a_zh: Chloramphenicol 選到的是供給質體，不是組裝產物。我們的 pSTK-0 entry vector 帶 chloramphenicol 抗性，Level 1 的目標載體 1A 到 1D 帶 ampicillin 抗性。所以那盤長出來的是反應裡沒被切掉的供給質體，不是真正組裝好的東西。會有菌落，但用 Level 1 篩選引子在任何一株都跑不出產物，因為那些細胞裡根本沒有 Level 1 的接點。處理方式就是重新劃到 ampicillin 盤上。這跟我們當初放棄 pGEM-T Easy 的標記邏輯一樣，它和目標載體共用 ampicillin。
questions.trap_en: Assuming the plate is simply dead and reporting no colonies. The donor plasmid is chloramphenicol resistant, so the plate fills with the wrong cells, which misleads more than an empty plate would.
questions.trap_zh: 以為那盤就是不會長、回答沒有菌落。供給質體本身就帶 chloramphenicol 抗性，所以盤上滿是錯的細胞，比空盤更容易誤導人。
questions.basis: no wiki answer; worked out from the team's own marker map

questions.q_en: Your no-DNA negative control plate comes up as a lawn. Give me the two most likely causes and the one experiment that tells them apart.
questions.q_zh: 你們不加 DNA 的陰性對照盤長成一片菌毯。說出兩個最可能的原因，以及一個可以分辨它們的實驗。
questions.a_en: Either the plate is not selecting or something resistant got in. Ampicillin plates lose potency with age, and once a few resistant cells grow they release beta-lactamase and clear the drug around them, which gives you a lawn or a fog of satellites. The other case is contamination of the competent cells or the recovery medium. One experiment separates them. Streak plasmid-free DH5 alpha from the freezer onto the same plate batch, and in parallel plate the recovery medium on its own. If the plasmid-free strain grows, the plates failed. If only the medium plate grows, the medium is the problem.
questions.a_zh: 要嘛那盤沒有在篩選，要嘛有帶抗性的東西進去了。Ampicillin 盤放久會失效，而且只要先長出幾顆抗性菌，它們釋出的 beta-lactamase 會把周圍的藥分解掉，就會變成一片菌毯或一團衛星菌落。另一種情況是勝任細胞或回復培養液被污染。一個實驗就能分辨：從冷凍管拿沒有質體的 DH5 alpha 劃到同一批盤上，同時單獨把回復培養液塗一盤。如果沒有質體的菌長起來，就是盤壞了；如果只有培養液那盤長，就是培養液的問題。
questions.trap_en: Blaming the enzyme or the ligation. A no-DNA control contains no DNA at all, so nothing about the assembly chemistry can explain growth on it.
questions.trap_zh: 把問題歸到酵素或接合反應。不加 DNA 的對照裡根本沒有 DNA，組裝反應的化學完全解釋不了它為什麼會長。
questions.basis: standard bench diagnosis; the wiki never describes this failure

questions.q_en: Your light-plate blots put the ACC deaminase band near 70 kDa when the monomer is about 35, and you offer a homodimer as the explanation. What else could put a band there, and what would settle it?
questions.q_zh: 你們光照板的 blot 把 ACC deaminase 的帶放在接近 70 kDa，而單體大約是 35 kDa，你們提出同源二聚體作為解釋。還有什麼可能造成那條帶？要怎麼定案？
questions.a_en: Seventy is almost exactly twice thirty-five, so whatever it is behaves like two copies, and that doubling is the whole clue. A dimer that survives SDS means the sample was not fully denatured, so under-boiling or tired reducing agent would do it. A duplicated cargo from the Golden Gate step would do it too. But our own August fractionation blot put the secreted enzyme at thirty-five to forty kilodaltons, and that is the same protein, which argues for sample handling rather than the construct. To settle it, re-boil with fresh reducing agent and run a plasmid-free WB800 lane beside it.
questions.a_zh: 70 幾乎正好是 35 的兩倍，所以不管那是什麼，它的行為就像兩份，而「剛好兩倍」就是關鍵線索。能在 SDS 下存活的二聚體，表示樣品沒有完全變性，煮不夠或還原劑放壞了都會這樣。Golden Gate 接出重複的貨物也會。但我們八月自己那張分層 blot 把分泌出來的酵素放在 35 到 40 kDa，那是同一個蛋白，這比較支持樣品處理的問題，而不是構築的問題。要定案就用新的還原劑重新煮沸再跑一次，旁邊加一道不帶質體的 WB800。
questions.trap_en: Accepting the dimer because the arithmetic works. Two copies fits a dimer, a duplication and an incompletely denatured sample equally well, and these blots carry no plasmid-free lane to exclude a host band.
questions.trap_zh: 因為數字剛好就接受二聚體的說法。兩份同樣符合二聚體、重複插入和沒有完全變性的樣品，而這些 blot 也沒有不帶質體的對照道可以排除宿主的帶。
questions.basis: the wiki names one possibility and leaves the reasoning open

questions.q_en: Suppose you repeat the August fractionation and this time the ACC deaminase sits in the pellet lanes with a blank supernatant. What are the two most likely causes, and how would you tell which it is?
questions.q_zh: 假設你重做八月那次分層實驗，這次 ACC deaminase 出現在沉澱道、上清液是空白。兩個最可能的原因是什麼？你要怎麼判斷是哪一個？
kw_zh: 持續表現把 Sec 塞住
questions.a_en: Either the Sec pathway is saturated or the signal peptide is not being cut. On a constitutive promoter the cell can make precursor faster than the translocase clears it, and unexported precursor stays inside, which puts it in the pellet. The other case is cleavage failing, which leaves the protein tethered at the membrane. The sizes separate them. A precursor still carries the thirty-one residue signal peptide, roughly three kilodaltons, so it runs heavier than the thirty-five to forty we see in the supernatant. Same size in the pellet means it was made and never exported; heavier means the peptide was not cut.
questions.a_zh: 要嘛 Sec 路徑被塞住，要嘛訊號肽沒被切掉。在持續型啟動子下，細胞做前驅蛋白的速度可能快過轉位酶清掉它，沒送出去的前驅蛋白留在細胞內，就會落在沉澱裡。另一種情況是切割失敗，蛋白被卡在細胞膜上。用大小就能分辨：前驅蛋白還帶著三十一個胺基酸的訊號肽，大約三 kDa，所以會比我們在上清液看到的 35 到 40 kDa 跑得高。沉澱裡的大小一樣，就表示做出來但沒送出去；比較大，就表示訊號肽沒被切。
questions.trap_en: Calling it a dead construct. A pellet band means the protein was made, so the failure is export or cleavage, which are different problems with different fixes.
questions.trap_zh: 說構築是壞的。沉澱裡有帶就表示蛋白做出來了，失敗的是分泌或切割，那是不同的問題、不同的解法。
questions.basis: hypothetical outcome; nothing on the wiki covers it

questions.q_en: Your His-tag ELISA standard curve runs from 3 down to 0.093 µg/mL, and you report ACC deaminase at 13.5 to 19.1. What is wrong with that number, and what would you do to the sample?
questions.q_zh: 你們 His-tag ELISA 的標準曲線從 3 µg/mL 到 0.093 µg/mL，但你們報出 ACC deaminase 是 13.5 到 19.1。那個數字有什麼問題？你會怎麼處理樣品？
questions.a_en: It is an extrapolation, not a measurement. Those wells read below twenty per cent of maximum binding, which is off the bottom of our standards, and in a competitive assay the signal falls as concentration rises, so beyond the last standard the curve is almost flat. A few milli-absorbance of noise then moves the answer by whole micrograms. The honest statement is that ACC deaminase reads higher than LEA14 and BoPep4, which is what we say. To fix it I would dilute about sixteen-fold, to land near the IC50 of 1.21, and check that two dilutions agree within twenty per cent.
questions.a_zh: 那是外插，不是量測。那些孔讀出來低於最大結合的百分之二十，已經掉出我們標準品的下緣；而競爭型分析的訊號是隨濃度上升而下降，所以超過最後一個標準品之後曲線幾乎是平的。這時候幾個 milli-absorbance 的雜訊，就會讓答案差上好幾微克。誠實的說法是 ACC deaminase 讀起來比 LEA14 和 BoPep4 高，我們頁面上就是這樣寫。要修正，我會稀釋大約十六倍，落在 IC50 的 1.21 附近，再確認兩個稀釋度彼此相差在百分之二十以內。
questions.trap_en: Treating 13.5 to 19.1 as a yield because it came off a fitted curve. The fit is only valid between the standards, and a 1:2 dilution does not bring a sixteen-microgram sample into range.
questions.trap_zh: 因為是從擬合曲線讀出來的，就把 13.5 到 19.1 當成產量。擬合只在標準品之間有效，而 1:2 稀釋根本不足以把十六微克的樣品帶進範圍內。
questions.basis: arithmetic the wiki implies but never works through

questions.q_en: Your six light arms on the nineteenth of September all grow between nought point two eight and nought point three two per hour, and you read that as no growth penalty. Estimate the burden you would expect from carrying the Level 2 device, and tell me whether that experiment could have seen it.
questions.q_zh: 9 月 19 日那六個光照組的生長速率都在每小時 0.279 到 0.317 之間，你們據此說誘導沒有生長代價。請估算帶著 Level 2 裝置本身會有多少負擔，並告訴我那個實驗能不能看到它。
kw_zh: 每一組都帶同一個質體
十 kb 對四百萬 bp
questions.a_en: That experiment could not have seen a plasmid burden, because every arm carried the same plasmid. It compares light conditions, not carrying the device against not carrying it. On size, our Level 2 device is 10,293 base pairs against a genome of about four million, so one copy is roughly a quarter of one per cent of the cell's DNA. Replication is therefore cheap and the real cost sits in translation and Sec throughput. We have no copy number for the shuttle vector on the wiki, so I cannot close the arithmetic. The honest test is a plasmid-free arm beside the carriers, with replicates, and we have not run it.
questions.a_zh: 那個實驗看不到質體負擔，因為每一組都帶同一個質體。它比較的是光照條件，不是「帶裝置」對「不帶裝置」。從大小看，我們的 Level 2 裝置是 10,293 bp，對上大約四百萬 bp 的基因體，一個拷貝大概是細胞 DNA 的千分之二點五。所以複製本身很便宜，真正的成本在轉譯和 Sec 的通量。Wiki 上沒有這個 shuttle vector 的拷貝數，所以這個算式我收不了尾。老實的做法是在旁邊加一組不帶質體的對照，而且要有重複，而我們沒有做。
questions.trap_en: Defending the six arms as evidence of no burden. They share the plasmid, so the comparison has no plasmid-free reference and cannot answer the question that was asked.
questions.trap_zh: 拿那六組當作沒有負擔的證據。它們共用同一個質體，整個比較沒有不帶質體的參考點，答不了被問的問題。
questions.basis: reasoning from the team's own numbers; conclusion stated nowhere

questions.q_en: On the His-tag ELISA your untransformed WB800 control reads about five micrograms per millilitre, the same range as four of your six constructs. Reason out what is producing that, and what you would do about it.
questions.q_zh: 在 His-tag ELISA 上，你們沒有轉形的 WB800 對照讀到大約 5 µg/mL，和六個構築裡的四個落在同一個範圍。請推論那個訊號是什麼造成的，以及你會怎麼處理。
kw_zh: 沒有質體就沒有重組蛋白
questions.a_en: It cannot be recombinant protein, because that strain has no plasmid. A competitive anti-His assay reads anything that competes with the labelled tracer for the antibody, so histidine-rich host proteins, or something in the Terrific Broth itself, can do it, and a rich medium is exactly where that happens. That means five micrograms is a floor on this assay, not a background I am entitled to subtract, unless I first show the two signals add. I would spike a known His standard into untransformed host supernatant and check the recovery, and until that works I would not rank constructs off this plate.
questions.a_zh: 那不可能是重組蛋白，因為那一株沒有質體。競爭型 anti-His 分析讀到的是任何會跟標記的 tracer 競爭抗體的東西，所以富含組胺酸的宿主蛋白，或 Terrific Broth 本身的成分，都可能造成，而豐富培養基正是最容易出事的地方。這表示 5 µg/mL 是這個分析的底線，不是我有資格直接相減的背景，除非我先證明兩個訊號是可以相加的。我會把已知濃度的 His 標準品加到沒有轉形的宿主上清液裡，檢查回收率；在那之前，我不會用這張盤替構築排名。
questions.trap_en: Subtracting the host reading from each construct. Subtraction assumes the two signals are additive, and that is exactly what this control has put in doubt.
questions.trap_zh: 把宿主的讀值從每個構築裡減掉。相減的前提是兩個訊號可以相加，而這個對照質疑的正是這一點。
questions.basis: the wiki reports the control; the explanation is not written

questions.q_en: You ran green and red at three intensities and the protein did not track intensity. Leaving aside the loading control and the plasmid-free lane you already name, what arms is that experiment still missing?
questions.q_zh: 你們跑了綠光和紅光各三個強度，蛋白量沒有隨強度變化。先不談你們已經提到的上樣對照和不帶質體的對照道，那個實驗還少了哪些組？
questions.a_en: A dark arm, and a strain that cannot see light. There is no dark condition anywhere in those twelve tubes, and red is not a substitute, because red is meant to drive the system to its off state, which is an active condition and not a baseline. Without dark I have no number for what the promoter does with no input, so I cannot say what fold change green bought. The second arm is a strain without the ho1 pcyA module: no chromophore means the photoreceptor is apoprotein, so it cannot respond to green however bright, which separates the circuit from heating by the LEDs.
questions.a_zh: 少了暗處組，也少了一株看不到光的菌。那十二管裡完全沒有暗處的條件，而紅光不能代替，因為紅光的作用是把系統推到關閉狀態，那是一個主動的條件，不是基線。沒有暗處，我就沒有「沒有輸入時啟動子做什麼」的數字，也就說不出綠光換到了幾倍。第二組是沒有 ho1 pcyA 模組的菌株：沒有色素基團，光受體就只是沒有輔基的蛋白，不管光多亮都不會對綠光反應，這樣才分得開迴路和 LED 的發熱。
questions.trap_en: Treating red at full intensity as the negative control. Red actively switches the system off through the same receptor, so it tests the off state rather than giving a no-input baseline.
questions.trap_zh: 把全強度的紅光當成陰性對照。紅光是透過同一個受體主動把系統關掉，所以它測的是關閉狀態，不是沒有輸入的基線。
questions.basis: experiment design beyond what the page already lists

questions.q_en: Take a cysteine-rich plant defensin with four disulfide bonds and put it through your own route, SamyQ and Bacillus subtilis into the supernatant. What breaks first?
questions.q_zh: 假設拿一個富含半胱胺酸、有四個雙硫鍵的植物 defensin，走你們自己的路線：SamyQ 加 Bacillus subtilis，分泌到上清液。最先壞掉的是哪一環？
kw_zh: Sec 送出去是未折疊的
questions.a_en: Folding breaks first, and we already have the result that says so. Bacillus subtilis exports through Sec in an unfolded state, so the protein has to fold outside the cell. That is why AmilCP failed as our secretion reporter: its beta barrel has to fold fast enough to hold its chromophore, and no colour ever appeared in the medium. Four disulfides formed outside the cell is the same problem, harder. So I would expect protein the anti-His ELISA can count and no activity at all. Proteolysis is the second worry, though WB800 has eight extracellular proteases deleted. We have never tried it.
questions.a_zh: 最先壞的是折疊，而我們已經有一個結果這樣告訴我們。Bacillus subtilis 透過 Sec 送出去的是未折疊的狀態，所以蛋白必須在細胞外折好。這就是 AmilCP 當分泌報告蛋白失敗的原因：它的 beta barrel 必須折得夠快才能抓住發色團，而培養液裡從來沒有出現顏色。要在細胞外形成四個雙硫鍵，是同樣的問題，而且更難。所以我預期會得到 anti-His ELISA 數得到、但完全沒有活性的蛋白。第二個顧慮是被蛋白酶切掉，不過 WB800 已經刪掉八個胞外蛋白酶。這個我們沒有做過。
questions.trap_en: Expecting the cloning or the codon optimisation to be the obstacle. Those set how much precursor is made; this molecule fails after it has already left the cell.
questions.trap_zh: 以為障礙在選殖或密碼子最佳化。那些決定的是前驅蛋白做多少；這個分子是離開細胞之後才失敗的。
questions.basis: transfer question; outside everything the team built

questions.q_en: Your fresh-culture arm gained signal from two to eight hours, but the arm you grew overnight first was strong at three and six hours and weaker at eight. Reason that out for me.
questions.q_zh: 你們直接放進板子的那一組訊號從 2 到 8 小時持續上升，但先養隔夜再放進去的那一組在 3 和 6 小時很強、8 小時變弱。請幫我推論原因。
kw_zh: 隔夜培養已接近穩定期
questions.a_en: The simplest reading is that production stopped rather than that protein was destroyed. The overnight arm starts near the end of growth, and our output promoter is a hybrid carrying a veg core, a growth-phase promoter, so its output should fall as the culture slows. The fresh arm is still accelerating, so it keeps gaining. I would not reach for protease, because WB800 has eight extracellular proteases deleted. To test it I would pair every blot lane with an OD600 and a loading control, then repeat the overnight arm in fresh medium at the same density. We have not done that, so this is a prediction.
questions.a_zh: 最簡單的解讀是生產停了，而不是蛋白被破壞掉。先養隔夜的那一組，一開始就接近生長末期，而我們輸出端的啟動子是帶 veg 核心的混合啟動子，屬於生長期型，所以培養物慢下來時輸出應該跟著下降。直接放進去的那一組還在加速，所以會一直往上。我不會先想到蛋白酶，因為 WB800 已經刪掉八個胞外蛋白酶。要驗證，我會讓每一道 blot 都配一個 OD600 和一個上樣對照，再用新鮮培養液在相同密度下重做隔夜那一組。我們還沒做，所以這是推論。
questions.trap_en: Calling the drop at eight hours protein degradation. WB800 is the protease-deleted strain, so degradation is the less likely of the two, and nothing on that blot distinguishes them without a loading control.
questions.trap_zh: 把 8 小時的下降說成蛋白降解。WB800 是刪掉蛋白酶的菌株，所以降解是比較不可能的那一個；而且沒有上樣對照，那張 blot 根本分不出來。
questions.basis: the wiki records the pattern and offers no explanation

questions.q_en: Your reactor supernatant holds three point four to six point five micrograms per millilitre of ACC deaminase. Roughly how many molecules has each cell had to make to get there?
questions.q_zh: 你們反應器的上清液裡 ACC deaminase 大約是 3.4 到 6.5 µg/mL。粗估一下，每個細胞大概要做出多少個分子才會到這個量？
kw_zh: 每 OD 十億個細胞
questions.a_en: Call it tens of thousands per cell. Take five micrograms per millilitre, which is five milligrams per litre, and divide by thirty-five thousand grams per mole: about one point four times ten to the minus seven moles per litre, so roughly ten to the fourteen molecules per millilitre. Our own figure is a billion cells per millilitre per OD unit, and run six reached about two point seven, so about three times ten to the nine cells. Divide and you land near thirty thousand copies per cell across the whole run. That is a real load for a secreted protein but not an impossible one.
questions.a_zh: 大概是每個細胞幾萬個。拿 5 µg/mL，也就是每公升 5 毫克，除以每莫耳三萬五千公克：大約是每公升 1.4 乘以十的負七次方莫耳，換成分子數大約是每毫升十的十四次方個。我們自己用的換算是每個 OD 單位每毫升十億個細胞，而第六次運轉到大約 2.71，所以大約是三乘以十的九次方個細胞。相除之後落在每個細胞三萬個左右，橫跨整段運轉。對一個分泌蛋白來說這是真實的負擔，但不是做不到的量。
questions.trap_en: Reading the concentration as a per-cell rate. It is an accumulated total in the medium over the whole run, so it divides by cells, not by cells per hour.
questions.trap_zh: 把濃度當成每個細胞的速率。那是整段運轉在培養液裡累積的總量，所以要除以細胞數，不是除以每小時的細胞數。
questions.basis: an order-of-magnitude the wiki never attempts

questions.q_en: The Level 2 reaction gives no colonies at all, three rounds running. What are the two most likely causes, and the one experiment that separates them?
questions.q_zh: Level 2 反應連續三輪都完全沒有菌落。兩個最可能的原因是什麼？哪一個實驗可以分辨？
kw_zh: 內部 BsaI 位點一直被切
questions.a_en: Stoichiometry, or a BsaI site that survived inside a module. With four inserts plus the destination, all five pieces have to meet in one complex, so the probability falls as a product and a bad insert to vector ratio can take you to zero. That is what happened to us: three consecutive rounds returned nothing with no design change, and sweeping one to five and one to seven on the twenty-eighth of August gave positives at all three junctions. The other cause is an internal BsaI site, which keeps recutting the product. The experiment is a two-part subset: if pairs join, it was stoichiometry, and if one pair always fails, that module carries the site.
questions.a_zh: 要嘛是比例問題，要嘛是某個模組裡還留著 BsaI 位點。四個插入加上目標載體，五個片段要在同一個複合物裡碰頭，機率是相乘的，所以插入與載體比例不對就可能直接掉到零。我們就遇過：連續三輪什麼都沒有、中間沒有改設計，8 月 28 日把比例掃過 1:5 和 1:7，三個接點都出現陽性。另一個原因是內部有 BsaI 位點，產物一直被切回去。實驗是先做兩個零件的子集：兩兩接得起來就是比例問題；某一對永遠失敗，那個模組就帶著位點。
questions.trap_en: Blaming the competent cells first. Transformation can be checked with a control plasmid in an afternoon, but it does not explain three rounds failing with cells that worked at Level 1.
questions.trap_zh: 先把問題推給勝任細胞。轉形效率拿一個對照質體一個下午就能驗，但它解釋不了用在 Level 1 成功過的細胞、連續三輪都失敗。
questions.basis: diagnosis exercise; the cause is not written out on any page

questions.q_en: Suppose you had to move one of these inserts by classical single-enzyme restriction and ligation, and you forgot to dephosphorylate the cut vector. What would the plate look like, and why does your Golden Gate workflow not need that step?
questions.q_zh: 假設你得用傳統的單一酵素切接把其中一個插入片段搬過去，而你忘了把切好的載體去磷酸化。平板會長成什麼樣子？為什麼你們的 Golden Gate 流程不需要那一步？
kw_zh: 一種酵素就是兩個相同末端
questions.a_en: The plate would be mostly empty vector. One enzyme leaves the vector two identical compatible ends, so it closes on itself, and a one-piece reaction beats a two-piece one, so the background swamps the real product. That is the pattern of our first MoClo screen, with bands at one height across almost every lane. Golden Gate does not need the phosphatase for two reasons. BsaI leaves two different four-base overhangs, so the vector cannot close on itself in frame, and any vector that does take its sfGFP dropout back still carries the enzyme sites and gets cut again, while the correct product has lost its sites and survives.
questions.a_zh: 平板上大部分會是空載體。用一種酵素切，載體就得到兩個完全一樣、彼此相容的末端，所以它會自己接起來；而單片段反應比雙片段反應快，所以背景會把真正的產物蓋掉。這就是我們第一次 MoClo 篩選的樣子，幾乎每一道的帶都在同一個高度。Golden Gate 不需要去磷酸化有兩個理由：BsaI 留下的是兩個不同的四鹼基黏端，載體沒辦法自己正確接回去；而且把自己的 sfGFP dropout 接回去的載體還帶著酵素位點，會被再切一次，而正確的產物已經失去位點，就留下來了。
questions.trap_en: Saying Golden Gate is clean because the enzyme is more specific. Specificity is not the point; directional overhangs and continuous recutting of the wrong product are what remove the need for a phosphatase.
questions.trap_zh: 說 Golden Gate 乾淨是因為酵素比較專一。重點不是專一性，而是方向性的黏端加上錯的產物會被持續切回去，這兩件事才讓去磷酸化變成不必要。
questions.basis: method the project never used; reason it out from first principles
